reviews.title: Good budget AIO to keep X3D chips cool.
reviews.comment: Bought for girlfriend's PC after she kept complaining about CPU temps on her 5800X3D. Ended up having to also buy her a case to fit the AIO, but that is a different story. AIO was great for price, performance, and looks.
reviews.author: johnyjoe2k

reviews.title: Easy to use water cooler
reviews.comment: Cooler master is a great product for a reasonable price. Cools good and no leaks or other problems.
reviews.author: Frederick P Thompson

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.comment: Cools nicely, looks great. Fans are fairly silent under normal use. Does make some bubbling noises but it’s expected.
reviews.author: anonymous

reviews.title: Solid unit for excellent performance.
reviews.comment: Solid piece of hardware. Was my first time building a rig so this wasn’t to difficult to get installed. Beautiful fans that move decent air out of the case. So performance meets my expectations. I guess it was a decent value for what I paid. Just wanted something to protect my investment.
reviews.author: Dee Smith

reviews.title: For the price, you can’t go wrong.
reviews.comment: Fuels well in my case, keeps my Ryzen 9 9900x cool, noise level can ramp up a bit on heavy cpu usage, but it is usually short lived and manageable. The construction of it seems durable and I trust it being in the case with my ASRock Taichi motherboard, something I definitely don’t want ruined. The aRGB colors look sharp, and the white version I purchased had no visible imperfections. As for instructions, well, they’re included and easy to read I suppose, but it isn’t a difficult item to install without instructions either.
reviews.author: Lisa Siwek
